AAG Education Management

A paperless school and college ERP for Odoo 20

Admissions, students, timetables, attendance, examinations and results, fees on native Odoo Invoicing, campus services, front office, certificates with QR verification, approvals and secure parent and student portals.

Replaces registers and spreadsheets with one system where every role sees only what it should.

Odoo 20.0 Community tested 30 security roles Multi-campus 203 automated tests

Role dashboard: every figure respects the viewer's record rules.

Key features

Admissions to enrolment

Enquiries with duplicate detection, admission cycles with seat limits, a public online form, merit lists, offers and one-click enrolment.

Timetable and attendance

Versioned timetables with conflict detection, daily, period and lab attendance, QR self check-in and a signed device webhook.

Examinations and results

Configurable grading, hall tickets, marks entry and import, moderation, approval before publication and report cards.

Fees on Odoo Invoicing

Fee structures and instalments become posted invoices billed to the paying guardian, with concessions, late fees and reminders.

Verifiable certificates

Certificates issued after approval, with a QR public verification page that discloses only the minimum.

Parent and student portal

Attendance, timetable, results, fees, documents and requests, each for the linked child only.

Admissions and students

Teaching and attendance

Examinations

Fees and finance

Campus services

  • Library circulation, reservations and fines; laboratory bookings, consumables and incidents.
  • Transport routes and capacity; hostel beds, roll-call and outings; assets and purchase requests.

Front office, welfare and security

  • Visitors with privacy retention, gate passes with pickup authorisation, grievances and announcements.
  • Health and counselling records for authorised staff only, with view logging.
  • 30 role groups, campus and company isolation; portal access checked per relationship.

Admit

Enquiries become applications; merit lists and offers lead to one-click enrolment.

Plan

Publish timetables; class sessions are generated around holidays.

3

Teach and track

Teachers mark attendance; parents see it in the portal.

Assess

Exams are scheduled, marked, moderated and published after approval.

5

Bill

Fee plans post invoices to the paying guardian and send reminders.

6

products.description:
Fuel Station Management System

The back office of a professional fuel retailer, inside Odoo 20 Community

Runs a petrol pump or a chain of stations in Odoo: tanks and dips with temperature correction, nozzle meters and shifts, cash and payment reconciliation, fuel receiving, wet-stock control, fleet credit and loyalty.

Every approved shift posts clean accounting on native Inventory, Purchase and Invoicing, so the owner sees stock, cash and margin per station without spreadsheets.

Odoo 20.0 Community Multi-station 12 security roles 54 automated tests

Owner dashboard with station and date filters.

Key features

Accounting you can audit

Each approved shift posts one retail invoice and one balanced settlement entry: cards and UPI to clearing accounts, cash to the cash journal, variances to their own accounts.

Wet-stock control

Every tank is a stock location. Dips, ASTM D1250-80 Table 54B temperature correction, daily reconciliation and statistical leak alerts.

Shifts and meters

Opening and closing totalizers, pump tests, rollover handling, cash count by denomination and manager approval of variances.

Fuel receiving

Purchase order to tanker arrival, pre and post dips per compartment, measured versus invoiced, tolerance checks and shortage claims.

Fleet, credit and loyalty

Fuel cards with product and volume limits, customer agreements, credit limits, statements, loyalty tiers and referral bonuses.

Station-level security

Twelve roles, station isolation, multi-company rules, locked documents and an immutable field-level audit trail.

Features in detail

Stations and tanks

  • Creating a station provisions its warehouse, analytic account, walk-in customer, cash journal, payment methods and shift schedule.
  • Calibration charts, certified or generated from tank geometry; water bottoms, overfill and low-stock alerts.
  • Dispensers and nozzles with electronic and mechanical totalizers; breakdowns raise maintenance requests.

Shift management

  • Opening totalizers and pump prices captured automatically; one open shift per nozzle.
  • Closing readings, pump tests, rollover handling and discrepancy detection.
  • Collections per payment method, denomination count, drops, deposits and petty cash.
  • Variance beyond tolerance needs an explanation and manager approval; printable closing report.

Receiving and wet stock

  • Measured versus invoiced quantity on an ambient or 15 degree C basis, with sales during decanting.
  • Manager approval of discrepancies, vendor bill with freight and shortage claim credit note.
  • Daily wet-stock reconciliation with tolerance, book adjustment and leak indicator.

Fleet, credit and pricing

  • Fleet vehicles, drivers and fuel cards with per-fill, daily and monthly limits.
  • Customer agreements: per-unit discount, percentage or fixed price, with periodic statement invoicing.
  • Effective-dated fuel prices with approval, promotions, coupons and loyalty points.

Reports and compliance

  • Excel and PDF exports: daily sales, meters, shift and cash, payment methods, tank stock, fuel loss, deliveries, fleet consumption, credit, commission, expenses, maintenance and audit.
  • Sales analysis by day, product, dispenser, nozzle and attendant; station profitability through analytic accounting.
  • Licence and certificate register with expiry alerts, configurable per country.

Integration

  • REST API with hashed device keys for automatic tank gauges and forecourt-controller middleware.
  • Role dashboards for owner, station manager, operations and finance.

How it works

1

Set up a station

Create the station, tanks with calibration charts, dispensers, nozzles and prices.

2

Open the shift

Opening totalizers and prices are captured; attendants sell on their nozzles.

3

Receive fuel

Dip before and after unloading; the measured quantity is booked into the tank.

4

Close and count

Enter closing readings and collections; the system computes expected cash and variances.

5

Approve and post

The manager approves; stock, the retail invoice and the settlement entry are posted once.

6

Reconcile wet stock

Daily book versus dip comparison flags losses and leaks.

FAQ

Questions before you buy

Does Nexora change how Odoo works?

No. It changes presentation and navigation only. Menus come from Odoo's own menu service, so access rights, multi-company rules and every module's menus are respected.

Will my third-party modules work?

Nexora styles Odoo's standard components, so modules built on them inherit the design. Modules that replace Odoo's navbar with their own (other backend themes) should not be combined with Nexora.

Where are user preferences stored?

On each user's res.users.settings record, so they follow the user across browsers and devices. Company defaults are system parameters edited in Settings.

Can I keep everyone on the same look?

Yes. Turn off 'Let users personalise the theme' in Settings. Administrators can still design a look and publish it as the default for everyone.

Does the dashboard need any configuration?

No. It detects installed apps (Sales, CRM, Invoicing, Purchase, Inventory, Project, Contacts) and shows only what each user may read.

Is dark mode available on Odoo Community?

Yes. Nexora provides the dark colour bundle for Community; on Enterprise it stays in sync with Odoo's own dark-mode preference.

What happens if I uninstall it?

Odoo removes the module's fields, views, menus and assets, and Nexora deletes its system parameters. The stock interface returns unchanged.

Is Odoo Online (SaaS) supported?

Do I need Odoo Enterprise?

The Odoo POS keeps selling offline. When it syncs again, kitchen tickets and ingredient deductions are created exactly once.

products.description:
Odoo 20.0Community & EnterpriseAIFree · LGPL-3

AI Gateway

One bring-your-own-key LLM gateway for every AI feature in Odoo.

AI Gateway gives your Odoo database a single, shared connection to Large Language Models — Anthropic Claude, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint or local Ollama models. Every AI feature uses the same provider settings, the same keys and the same usage and cost log.

✓ Claude, OpenAI-compatible & Ollama✓ Your own API key✓ Token & cost log✓ PII redaction

The challenge

Each AI add-on usually brings its own API key field, its own model settings and no record of what it spent. Keys end up scattered across modules, nobody can see which feature is driving the bill, and switching provider means reconfiguring everything.

The solution

Configure providers and keys once. Every module calls the same gateway, picks a speed/quality tier, and every request is logged with tokens, estimated cost, duration and the calling feature — so AI usage is visible, controlled and cheap to extend.

Key features

Everything you need, nothing you don't

Bring your own key

You supply the provider API key — no token resale and no per-seat AI fee. Keys are readable by AI Managers only.

Tiered model routing

Callers ask for Fast, Balanced, Smart or Max and the gateway picks the configured model for the active provider.

Four provider types

Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI-compatible APIs, local Ollama, and a built-in Mock provider for tests and demos without a key.

Usage & cost log

Every request records tokens, estimated USD cost, duration, model, calling module and status (OK, Refused, Error).

Privacy controls

Content logging is optional and off by default; optional redaction masks email addresses and long numbers in stored previews.

Daily quotas

Mark a provider as a shared free tier and cap requests per user per day.

Feature details

What's inside

Providers

✓Provider records with type, base URL, API key and per-tier model names
✓Enable / disable providers and order them by sequence
✓Test Connection button on each provider
✓Request counter and a smart button to the provider's logs

Usage log

✓Input, output and total tokens per request
✓Estimated cost in USD and duration in milliseconds
✓Source module, user, company, tier and model
✓Optional prompt and response previews

Settings

✓Default provider and default tier
✓Default maximum tokens per request
✓Switch request logging on or off
✓Store previews and redact PII in logs

Security

✓AI User and AI Manager groups
✓API key field restricted to AI Managers
✓Multi-company record rules on providers and logs

How it works

Up and running in minutes

1

Add a provider

Create a provider, choose its type, paste your API key and confirm with Test Connection.

2

Pick defaults

In Settings choose the default provider, tier, token limit and logging options.

3

Install AI apps

AI modules built on the gateway call it automatically — no extra keys to enter.

4

Watch usage

Open Request Logs to see tokens, cost and errors, grouped by provider, module or user.

Screenshots

See it in action

Screenshots were taken on Odoo 19. On Odoo 20 the same screens follow that version's standard look.

All your AI providers in one list

Claude, OpenAI-compatible, Ollama and Mock providers side by side.

Per-provider model routing and Test Connection

Map the Fast, Balanced, Smart and Max tiers to the models you want.

Every request logged with tokens and cost

Group by provider, module or status to find what drives your bill.

Simple, privacy-first settings

Default provider and tier, token limit, logging and PII redaction.

For developers

Call it from any module

Add ai_gateway to your module's dependencies and call one method. A status of error is a soft failure, so your feature can fall back to manual work instead of breaking.

res = self.env['ai.gateway'].chat(
    messages=[{'role': 'user', 'content': 'Summarise this bill: ...'}],
    tier='balanced',            # fast | balanced | smart | max
    source='my_module.feature')
if res['status'] == 'ok':
    text = res['text']   # also: model, provider, tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms

Setup & compatibility

Setup

1.Install AI Gateway (the Python requests package is required).
2.Go to AI Gateway › Configuration › Providers, open a provider and enter your API key (or the URL of your Ollama server).
3.Click Test Connection, then set the default provider and tier in Settings › AI Gateway.
4.Give users the AI User group; keep AI Manager for whoever manages keys.

Note: API usage is billed by your AI provider under your own account. The Mock provider works without a key for testing.

products.summary: Families, members, sacramental registers & certificates, dues & donations, facility bookings, events, attendance and pastoral care for Odoo Community
products.description:
ParishCore

Church and parish management for Odoo 20 Community

Families and members, sacramental registers and certificates, dues and offerings with proper accounting, facility bookings, services, events, attendance and pastoral care, in one app on your own server.

It replaces paper registers, spreadsheet dues and double-booked halls with records the parish office can trust.

Odoo 20.0 Community Runs on your own server No third-party dependencies 179 automated tests

ParishCore home: tiles, quick actions and search.

Key features

Registers done right

Numbered, locked register books with notations and corrections, never edited in place. Certificates come from the register with a verification code.

Dues and offerings

Monthly subscriptions generate themselves; a Quick Receipt takes a family's dues in seconds and every payment becomes a journal entry.

No double bookings

The database itself refuses overlapping hall bookings; prices, deposits and refunds follow your rules.

Families and members

Households, relationships, transfers in and out, membership history and consent per channel.

Pastoral care

Visits, care lists and prayer requests, with confidential notes revealed only through a logged action.

Privacy built in

Role-based access, an append-only audit log, data export and anonymisation, and no data sent anywhere unless you configure messaging.

Features in detail

Families and members

  • Built on Odoo contacts: family and member numbers (keep your old ones on import), head of family, shared address.
  • Transfers with a dues check and a printed transfer letter; custom fields without programming.
  • Parish structure with up to three levels (for example Zone, Ward, Family Unit).

Sacramental registers

  • Baptism, Confirmation, First Communion, Marriage, Death and Burial, and configurable ceremonies.
  • Workflow with document checklist from draft to registered; corrections are approved notations.
  • Gap-free numbering, import of old registers with original numbers, printed register books and index.

Dues, receipts and accounting

  • Monthly, quarterly, yearly or one-off contributions, arrears, waivers and write-offs with approval limits.
  • Sunday collections counted by denomination with two counters and a verifier.
  • Every receipt, collection, expense, booking and refund becomes an Odoo Invoicing journal entry; cancellations are reversed.

Bookings, services and events

  • Halls and grounds with opening hours, member prices, surcharges and refundable deposits; recurrence and maintenance blocks.
  • Weekly service schedules, events with volunteers and budget, one parish calendar, attendance with absence flags.

Groups and communication

  • Groups, ministries, committees and classes with roles and terms; leaders see only their people.
  • Email through Odoo, WhatsApp click-to-chat without a paid API, SMS through Odoo's SMS module if enabled.

Reports and setup

  • Membership, sacraments, collections, arrears ageing and facility use as pivots and charts.
  • Church Setup applies the terms of your tradition (Catholic Latin, Syro-Malabar, Syro-Malankara, Malankara Orthodox, Jacobite, Mar Thoma, CSI, Anglican, Pentecostal and others).
  • Excel and CSV import templates with a data check afterwards.

How it works

1

Set up the parish

Run Church Setup for your tradition and import families with the templates.

2

Record members

Keep households, transfers and consent current.

3

Collect dues

Monthly dues generate; the counter takes payments with Quick Receipt.

4

Keep registers

Prepare, celebrate and register sacraments; issue certificates.

5

Book and gather

Book halls, schedule services and events, and track attendance.

6

Report

Print statistics, statements and registers for the parish council.

products.summary: Hindu temple ERP: poojas, sevas, vazhipadu, donations, hundi, halls, festivals and audit-grade fund accounting, with or without Odoo Accounting
products.description:
Temple Management System

Poojas, sevas, donations, hundi, halls and festivals with audit-grade fund accounting, for Odoo 20 Community

Runs the whole temple office: a fast counter that prints receipts in seconds, a pooja register for the priests, devotees and families with their nakshatra, donations into the right funds, hundi counting with witnesses, hall bookings, festivals, memberships and dues.

Every rupee received or spent becomes a balanced posting in the temple ledger, and a real journal entry when Odoo Accounting is installed.

Odoo 20.0 Community Works with or without Accounting Depends only on Base and Discuss 95 automated tests

Temple dashboard: collections today, poojas, donations, dues, festivals and fund balances.

Key features

A counter built for queues

Find the devotee by phone, type a short code such as AR*2, take cash, UPI, card or cheque and print: booking, gapless receipt, payment and posting in one step.

Money handled in the open

Cash sessions with denomination counts; hundi boxes opened before witnesses, counted by two teams, verified and posted by different people.

Accounts your auditor accepts

Restricted, designated and corpus funds kept apart; advance bookings held as liabilities until the pooja is performed.

Pooja register

Today's poojas with devotee, star, deity, priest and status; priests mark them performed and the coordinator can auto-assign.

Halls and festivals

Hall bookings with deposits and cleaning buffers, festivals with sponsorships, budget and net result.

Tamper-evident audit

Append-only audit log with an optional SHA-256 hash chain, period lock and separate rights for sensitive data.

Features in detail

Counter and receipts

  • Search by phone, devotee ID or name; short codes with quantities; Ctrl+Enter to confirm and print.
  • Several poojas, beneficiaries and a donation on one receipt; split payments with references.
  • Gapless numbering per counter and financial year; cancellations need a reason and reverse the posting.
  • A5 or thermal receipts with amount in words, donor-deduction text and a QR verification code.

Poojas and sevas

  • Fixed, minimum or open prices, slots, daily capacity, lead time and the days each is performed.
  • Nakshatra, gotra or beneficiary asked only where the offering needs it.
  • Advance bookings recognised as income on the day; cancellation refunds by notice period; recurring bookings.

Devotees, donations and funds

  • Devotee ID, name in local script, nakshatra, family; consent per channel; masked sensitive data.
  • Donation types mapped to funds; restricted funds released only when spent; corpus never treated as income.
  • Receipts under s.354 of the Income-tax Act, 2025 (formerly s.80G) and donor statement data for Form 113 (formerly 10BD).

Hundi

  • Seal numbers and a minimum number of witnesses before a box is opened.
  • Two counting teams; a counter cannot verify and the verifier cannot post.
  • Foreign currency, valuables register, deposit slip and printed counting proceedings.

Halls, festivals and memberships

  • Hourly, half-day or daily rates, refundable deposits, cleaning buffers; double bookings refused; GST on hall rent above the threshold.
  • Festival programme, budget, sponsorship packages with sponsor limits.
  • Annual and life memberships, recurring contributions, overdue dues collected at the counter.

Accounting and reports

  • Configurable posting rules: one balanced, idempotent posting per event; corrections are reversals.
  • Temple Ledger, Daily Collection, Trial Balance, Income and Expenditure with fund columns, Receipts and Payments.
  • Optional Odoo Accounting integration from a cut-over date, with journals and an analytic account per restricted fund.

How it works

1

Configure

Deities, poojas and sevas with codes, funds, counters and roles.

2

Serve devotees

The counter books poojas and takes donations in seconds.

3

Perform

Priests work from the day's pooja register.

4

Count hundi

Witnessed opening, double counting, verification and posting.

5

Close the day

Count the cash, verify the session and deposit to the bank.

6

Report

Ledgers, fund statements and audit-ready reports for the trust.

products.description:
Odoo 20.0Community & EnterpriseMarketing

WhatsApp Cloud API Connector

Send and receive WhatsApp messages in Odoo through the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API.

Connect Odoo directly to the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API — no third-party gateway. Bring your own WhatsApp Business Account, sync your approved message templates, send template or free-text messages from any contact, and receive replies and delivery/read receipts through the inbound webhook.

✓ Official Cloud API✓ Template sync✓ Inbound webhook✓ Delivery & read receipts

The challenge

Customers prefer WhatsApp, but conversations happen on personal phones with no record in Odoo.

The solution

Messages are sent from your business number and logged in Odoo, with statuses and replies coming back automatically.

Key features

Everything you need, nothing you don't

Your own number

One or more WhatsApp Business accounts: Phone Number ID, WABA ID, access token and API version.

Message templates

Sync Meta-approved templates and fill body variables from the record.

Send from Odoo

A Send WhatsApp action on contacts and a composer for template or free-text messages.

Two-way

Inbound messages and delivery, read and failure statuses arrive through a signed webhook.

Opt-in

Optionally send only to contacts who opted in.

Outbox & retries

Queued messages are processed by a scheduled action; failed ones can be retried.

Feature details

What's inside

Accounts

✓Test Connection and Sync Templates buttons
✓Webhook URL and verify token shown on the account
✓App secret for webhook signature checks
✓Simulation mode for testing without Meta

Messages

✓Outbound and inbound, template or text
✓Queued, Sent, Delivered, Read, Received or Failed
✓Linked to the contact and the source record
✓Message history per contact

How it works

Up and running in minutes

1

Connect

Enter your Cloud API credentials and test the connection.

2

Set the webhook

Register the webhook URL and verify token in Meta.

3

Sync templates

Pull your approved templates into Odoo.

4

Message

Send from contacts; replies and receipts come back automatically.

Screenshots

See it in action

Screenshots were taken on Odoo 19. On Odoo 20 the same screens follow that version's standard look.

Connect your WhatsApp Business number

Send, receive and track messages in Odoo

Setup & compatibility

Install, configure, go

Setup

1.Create a WhatsApp Business app in Meta and get the Phone Number ID, WABA ID and a permanent access token.
2.Install the module (Python package requests required).
3.Open WhatsApp › Configuration › Accounts, enter the credentials, Test Connection and Sync Templates.
4.Register the account's webhook URL and verify token in Meta; set defaults in Settings › WhatsApp.

Note: Your Odoo must be reachable over HTTPS for Meta to deliver webhooks. Meta's WhatsApp pricing applies to your account.
